VOTE NAY: 2013-03-20 Bill C-279, An Act to amend the Canadian Human Rights Act and the Crim (Agreed To) [never places: TEXT READ 2 October 2026. The sponsor's own amendment NARROWING his bill: it takes "gender expression" out of every clause. On its face a Yea is our direction, but it was cast by the bill's supporters to carry it, and the Conservative Nay was opposition to the bill, not to the narrowing. It split as the third reading (645): 282 of the 283 members who voted on both voted the same way (one exception, Ryan Leef, not sitting). The readings already carry C-279 (271 at +/-1, 645 at +/-2); a value here would either reward the bill's supporters or count the same vote twice.
